🧊 Cube method

Your layers stacked into a cube: rows × columns × numbers. Every line through the cube must hold exactly one block. Drag to rotate. The simulation solves this puzzle from its givens — spoiler!

Slice mode: each number is one horizontal slice. The thinnest slices are opened first (most repeated number; ties: fewest free cells in a box): every option layer of that slice is listed, then the pillars link the slices — a full pillar cuts the options of every other slice. A slice with one option left is 🔒 locked and never revisited.
